QUICK INCOME IN JUST 30 MINUTES!

CLICK HERE TO APPLY AND GET STARTED!

Looking for an easy way to earn extra money online? Join TELUS Digital’s Face Deduplication Collection Project!

The project collects photos showing different lighting, poses, expressions, accessories, environments, and changes in appearance over time to help improve AI and facial recognition models. The collection includes:

• Current Neutral Selfies – clean frontal selfies serving as high-quality identity references, with natural variation in appearance and surroundings.

• Current Head-Pose Captures – selfies captured in assigned head directions to introduce pose variation.

• Historical Images – older photos from participants’ galleries to capture natural aging and long-term appearance changes.

PAYMENT

  • Submit at least 20 valid images to qualify for payment.

  • Payment is capped at 24 accepted images.

  • We recommend submitting 30 images to account for images that may be rejected during quality checks.

  • All submissions must pass automated and manual quality control (QC)

.

Earn $14 USD upon successfully meeting the project requirements.

Your photos will help improve AI and facial recognition technology by capturing different poses, lighting, and changes in appearance over time.

Anyone can apply!

Originally posted on Himalayas
